_readme: Exposure decisions for the tool parity audit (scripts/tool-parity.mjs). Every row visible on either surface (an MCP `tool.op`, or a playground-only tool) must be recorded here as 'gap' (absence is a defect to fix) or 'deliberate' (absence is design, with the reason). Unannotated tools fail `bun run tool:parity --check`. Seeded from docs/design/TOOL-SYSTEM.md's exposure matrix.

pyric.can_i_use.reason: Shared MCP and Playground trust query; the CLI/MCP retain full claims while the browser receives only the measured compact projection

build_game_rules.reason: Playground skill-specific authoring workflow, activated only by its skill; not a general MCP primitive

debug_firestore_rules.reason: Playground orchestration wrapper; external agents compose the MCP rules and inspection primitives directly

firestore_data.add.reason: attached-sandbox CRUD belongs in MCP; the Playground uses its native session workspace instead of duplicating the bridge data plane
